title: Consumption Schedule - Data API
description: A consumption schedule organizes a set of consumption rates by which usage-based products are quoted and billed. This object is available in API version 45.0 and later.

BillingTerm.description: The number used with the billing term unit to determine billing frequency.

BillingTermUnit.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
BillingTermUnit.description: The unit used with the billing term to determine billing frequency Possible values are: Month— Quarter— Year—

CurrencyIsoCode.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
CurrencyIsoCode.description: Available only for orgs with the multicurrency feature enabled. Possible values are: AUD—Australian Dollar CAD—Canadian Dollar GBP—British Pound JPY—Japanese Yen USD—U.S. Dollar

IsActive.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
IsActive.description: Indicates whether this record is active (true) or not (false). Label is Active.

LastReferencedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last accessed this record, a record related to this record, or a list view.

LastViewedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last viewed this record or list view. If this value is null, the user might have only accessed this record or list view (LastReferencedDate) but not viewed it.

MatchingAttribute.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
MatchingAttribute.description: Salesforce Billing matches usage with a consumption schedule if the records share Matching Attribute value.

Name.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Sort, Update
Name.description: Default name of this record. Label is Product Name.

NumberOfRates.description: The number of consumption rates in this consumption schedule.

OwnerId.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
OwnerId.description: The user who owns a consumption schedule record. This is a polymorphic relationship field.

RatingMethod.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
RatingMethod.description: A specific use case to rate usage against the schedule. This field is the controlling picklist for the Type field. Possible values are: Tier

SBQQ__Category__c.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
SBQQ__Category__c.description: This field is available only with Salesforce CPQ. You can define custom categories to organize consumption schedules in separate tabs on sales rep UI. If you do this, make sure to create a field set for each category. Possible values are: Rates

Type.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
Type.description: Defines how rate tiers are calculated. Possible values are: Range—The schedule prices only using the tier that applies to the usage quantity. Slab—Usage within a given bound receives pricing equal to its tier’s value.

UnitOfMeasure.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
UnitOfMeasure.description: A unit of measure defines how you quantify instances of usage for your usage products. For example, if your usage product is a cloud storage subscription, you could provide a value of GB for your unit of measure.

blng__BillingRule__c.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
blng__BillingRule__c.description: This field is available only with Salesforce Billing. Salesforce Billing invoices usage summaries based off their related consumption schedule's billing rule.

blng__RevenueRecognitionRule__c.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
blng__RevenueRecognitionRule__c.description: This field is available only with Salesforce Billing. Salesforce Billing recognizes usage summary revenue based off the summary's related revenue recognition rule.

blng__TaxRule__c.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
blng__TaxRule__c.description: This field is available only with Salesforce Billing. Salesforce Billing taxes usage summary invoice lines based off the summary's related tax rule.
